skills.description: Establish a source-backed company position from the website, connected channels, analytics, leads, campaigns, and market signals.
Establish current company state from retained evidence and live signals.
Decide whether evidence supports action or requires targeted observation.
Identify the highest-leverage evidenced business constraint.
Create one bounded stage with metrics, thresholds, and stop conditions.
Delegate a measurable result contract to one appropriate specialist Room.
Compare stage evidence with its decision rule and choose the next transition.
Explain measured movement without inventing attribution or causality.
Promote verified outcomes and decisions into compact company memory.
Resolve access, evidence, policy, or execution blockers safely.
Build a location-grounded client acquisition motion from company evidence, qualified local prospects, and connected outreach tools without inventing contacts or sending unapproved messages.
